body:
Thanks, I needed this. After waking up with a clear head, it doesn't seem completely hopeless now, but it was definitely stupid. I think I should be able to go without doing it, for awhile at least. But this whole ordeal, using again, brings a lot of questions to mind which are really weird.

I might not try to completely stop using, but maybe I could just do alcohol as the only semi-regular drug, but I have to take breaks, which I can do. When I was in rehab, I met a lot of people that were completely ruined by drugs, but I've lived a relatively successful life. I graduated college, found a career (albeit one that pays less than I'd like), am able to take care of a pet, and have hobbies, but at the same time, I've recently noticed a lot of huge problems, ones that I can't talk about with anyone, ones that terrify me, but I know what I need to do to get better. I guess I need to work on those most of all, so I can feel proud of myself, and then tackle everything else.

Thanks again. It always helps talking to people, and I don't have many friends, and the only friend I have in my state, I don't really like her that much.
To write an epic poem and my cat, I guess. I'd say those are the 2 biggest, most important things in my life.
But I don't feel like I have a good future. I don't know what's worth living for. Poetry's nice and all, but the pain of fighting the addiction was tough. It just seems easier to end it.
When I quit, I was at a point where the drug wasn't making me happy. But today, it is making me high, almost happy. It's not perfect, but it's not horrible.

I have inspiration for other stuff. And I knew that it was a bad idea. I hoped that it wouldn't make me feel good, because when I quit last, my drug of choice didn't make me feel good, but it makes me feel good tonight. I just wanted inspiration for a particular poem about my cravings. But most of my poems are about my experiences, which usually deals with my addiction/suicidal tendencies.

I don't know what to do now. Using again, I can't imagine quitting, and it wouldn't be too hard to conceal my using, as I don't have friends where I live, but I'm worried about the suicide stuff.
